sloka: न त्वेनमवगच्छन्ति गुणदोषमसत्स्त्रिय: ।कामवक्तव्यहृदया भर्तृनाथा श्चरन्ति या: ॥ २.११७.२४॥
transliteration: na tvenamavagacchanti guṇadoṣamasatstriya: ।kāmavaktavyahṛdayā bhartṛnāthā ścaranti yā: ॥ 2.117.24॥

translations.english: O Sita, on reflection I know of none who is a better friend than the husband. He, like an imperishable penance, once acquired is never lost.
